purpose: Second LIBERO-Plus 280 panel (panel B) for the A16 comparison arms, so each arm has 560 closed-loop episodes with panel A; same runtime as fastwam-a16-baselines-20261028 (dequantized dense BF16 weights, T5 cache, condition cache + CUDA Graph)

panel_b.selection: from each of the 28 suite/dimension cells of the 1,400-row official pilot pool, drop the 10 panel-A variants and pick 10 of the remaining 40 with the panel-A greedy balance (original_task, subtype, task/subtype pair, difficulty), seed 20261031 + cell index
panel_b.seeds: slot index = 280 + position, so env seed 800000000 + 1000*index and sampler seeds 900000000 + 1000*index + replan never repeat panel A
panel_b.invalid_rule: a variant whose task completes during the 30 dummy settling steps is invalid; settling uses no policy action, so validity is the same for every arm and the slot is dropped from every arm

schedule.rule: every worker slot picks the arm with the most unclaimed episodes per worker (unclaimed / (active + 1)); it joins an arm that already has workers only if unclaimed / active >= join_min, so a reload (~5.5 min) is paid only while the arm still has several episodes per worker left; episodes are claimed by atomic mkdir on GPFS, so slots on both nodes share one queue per arm

allocation.gpu_memory_note: one worker holds ~14.8 GB on an A100-40GB (26069268: 29.6 GB for two), so two slots per GPU
